summary: Recorded in Washington, DC before the 2018 Unite the Right 2 counter-protest, this episode uses leaked chat logs to examine the post-2016 American neo-Nazi and fascist groups, their organiser Jason Kessler, and their tactics for disguising racism and provoking violence.

evidence.note: Recorded on location in DC ahead of counter-protesting Unite the Right 2.0
Episode built on Unicorn Riot leaks of far-right group chat logs
Kessler introduced as the figure who best embodies the first post-2016 wave
YouTube videos and Gamergate as radicalisation paths; internet theme
June 2017 planning of the original Unite the Right rally
Entryism and optics: blending in as mainstream conservatives; propaganda theme
Kekistan flag explained as a recoloured Nazi naval flag; nazism theme
Chats sharing explosives manuals and planning a church shooting; terrorism theme
Anti-Com founder revealed among those discussing an attack
Traditional Workers Party collapse in March 2018

notes: Hybrid of on-location protest reporting and a researched overview, classed current-affairs per the format examples. Primary is the diffuse movement, so roles are empty; Kessler gets the longest individual segment. Traditional Workers Party and Patriot Prayer also get real time but hit the five-subject cap. Kessler birth year 1983 from general knowledge.
